description.text: The first Gym expansion pack, released in Japan on 24 October 1998 to go with the Pokémon Gym starter decks. Its Pokémon belong to the Gym Leaders Brock, Misty, Lt. Surge and Erika, or to Team Rocket, and each carries its owner's name. Its cards went into the English Gym Heroes, released in August 2000.
